/** @typedef {{ id: string; name: string; category: string; price: number; badge?: string; filter: string[]; imageRef: number; blurb: string }} Product */

/** @type {Product[]} */
export const PRODUCTS = [
  {
    id: "p1",
    name: "Ethiopian Yirgacheffe",
    category: "beans",
    price: 18.99,
    badge: "New",
    filter: ["new", "popular"],
    imageRef: 1,
    blurb: "250g • Medium Roast"
  },
  {
    id: "p2",
    name: "Chemex Pour-Over Brewer",
    category: "gear",
    price: 44.99,
    badge: "Popular",
    filter: ["popular"],
    imageRef: 2,
    blurb: "Classic glass brewer"
  },
  {
    id: "p3",
    name: "Almond Croissant",
    category: "snacks",
    price: 4.5,
    badge: "Sale",
    filter: ["sale", "under20"],
    imageRef: 3,
    blurb: "Buttery & flaky"
  },
  {
    id: "p4",
    name: "Dark Roast Sumatra",
    category: "beans",
    price: 16.99,
    badge: "Popular",
    filter: ["popular", "under20"],
    imageRef: 4,
    blurb: "Bold & smoky"
  },
  {
    id: "p5",
    name: "Handcrafted Clay Mug",
    category: "mugs",
    price: 14.99,
    badge: "New",
    filter: ["new", "under20"],
    imageRef: 5,
    blurb: "Artisan glaze"
  },
  {
    id: "p6",
    name: "Cold Brew Concentrate",
    category: "coffee",
    price: 12.0,
    badge: "Sale",
    filter: ["sale", "under20"],
    imageRef: 6,
    blurb: "1L bottle"
  }
];

export const CATEGORIES = [
  { id: "all", label: "All" },
  { id: "coffee", label: "Coffee" },
  { id: "beans", label: "Beans" },
  { id: "gear", label: "Gear" },
  { id: "snacks", label: "Snacks" },
  { id: "mugs", label: "Mugs" }
];

export const FILTERS = [
  { id: "all", label: "All" },
  { id: "new", label: "New" },
  { id: "sale", label: "Sale" },
  { id: "popular", label: "Popular" },
  { id: "under20", label: "Under $20" }
];
